name: Akii: SEO & AI Search Optimizer
summary: MIT-licensed Claude Code plugin with 12 SEO and AI-search skills, five agents and three commands for audits, content planning, schema and link checks.
description: Install the repository as a Claude Code marketplace, then install akii-seo-ai-search-optimizer@akii. Runs in your existing Claude Code session on macOS/Linux; no Akii login or subscription, but Claude Code, model use and optional data tools have their own costs. AI visibility uses public-signal proxies or a connected Ahrefs Brand Radar MCP, not direct engine queries or continuous tracking. At commit baae244, a SessionEnd hook sends default-on telemetry to https://akii.com/api/plugin-telemetry at most once per machine per 24 hours: plugin version, a truncated SHA-256 hash of the machine identifier, OS and timestamp. Telemetry defaults off for Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and Anthropic-on-AWS provider flags. The hook also checks GitHub releases for updates (24-hour cache) and shows an Akii promotional link each session. All 12 skill, five agent and three command templates end with akii.com promotional links. AKII_PLUGIN_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1, DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 suppress telemetry only, not the hook's promotion or update check. AKII_PLUGIN_DISABLE_CTA=1 disables the entire SessionEnd hook, but does not remove the separate skill/agent/command promotional footers. The free plugin is separate from the historical Akii SaaS.

agent_access.notes: Public Claude Code plugin: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/akii-technologies-ltd/akii-seo-ai-search-optimizer then /plugin install akii-seo-ai-search-optimizer@akii. No Akii account needed.
